name: People of Determination Card
summary: A federal card that recognises the holder as a person of determination across the UAE.
audience: UAE nationals who are people of determination
Residents who are people of determination, where eligible
description: The People of Determination Card is issued by the Ministry of Community Development and recognises the holder as a person of determination across the UAE. It is used as proof of status when requesting exemptions, concessions and support services from federal and local entities. Applications are submitted through the Ministry's digital services and require a disability classification issued after an assessment.

eligibility.question: Do I need to be assessed first?
eligibility.requirement: The applicant must hold a disability classification issued following an assessment recognised by the Ministry of Community Development.

eligibility.question: What identity document do I need?
eligibility.requirement: A valid Emirates ID is required; family book or passport details may also be requested.

processingTime: Not published on the source page.
channels: Online through the Ministry of Community Development digital services
In person at a Ministry of Community Development customer happiness centre
